name: Mozzarella & Bruschetta Grilled Chicken with Balsamic Glaze

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place a small saucepan on medium-high heat; add balsamic vinegar and brown sugar; stir until sugar is dissolved. Cook until reduced by half, or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, 10-15 minutes. Once done, remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken breasts in half horizontally, forming thin fillets.
Mix the spices together in a small bowl. Rub chicken fillets with the spice mixture on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp oregano
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
When hot, coat grill pan with oil.
Place the chicken fillets in the grill pan; cook until they are golden brown and cooked through, 5-6 minutes per side. Once done, remove from heat.
Preheat oven to broil and position rack under the broiler. Line a baking sheet with foil for easy clean-up (optional).
Small dice the tomatoes and transfer to a large bowl.
Peel and mince the shallots and garlic and add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes. Add the oil, salt, and pepper and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper
1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place cooked chicken on the baking sheet pan. Top with sliced mozzarella. Place in the oven and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese begins to melt.
To serve, divide the chicken between plates, top with tomato mixture, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze. Enjoy!
